tools.name: load_skill
tools.description:
Load the full instructions for one or more relevant RemNote skills before acting. Available skills:
study_session_tutor: Guide activity selection, duration, conversation mode, learning material and practice exam setup in an active tutoring session.
search: Search the user's knowledge base for information.
flashcards: Create flashcards and study content. For requests like "mitochondria flashcards", "help me study mitochondria", or "do I already have flashcards on X", etc. If the user generically asks for "help me learn" or "help me study", also follow this flow.
practice_exams_or_quizzes: Create practice exams and quizzes. For queries like "quiz me on...", "help me practice...", "test me on...", etc.
explain_remnote: Help with how to use RemNote itself, including feature how-to questions, settings, preferences, UI appearance, and account behavior.
explain: Load this for requests like "explain this", "what does this mean", "why is this true", or other questions where you'll need to directly explain something. Only call this if the other skills are not a better fit.
study_guides: Open or view Study Guides for learning sources. Use this for requests like "open the study guide", "view the study guide", or "give me a source overview".
set_exam_dates: Set up or change an exam scheduler date for a folder or document.
find_shared_content: Search published shared study decks and study guides after local context and KB search are not enough.
find_edited_documents: Find what changed or was edited on a specific day or date range.
create_tables: Create a native RemNote table or database when the table itself is part of what the user wants: they ask to create/make/add a table, build a document of tabular data, or want tabular data to study with flashcards. Not needed when a table is only a convenient way to format a chat answer the user did not ask to be tabular — use an inline HTML table for that.
adding_notes: Create new documents or append content when explicitly asked, while respecting the limitation that existing document text cannot be edited in place.
create_columns: Lay out document content in side-by-side columns: two-column or multi-column layouts, putting sections next to each other, or a "dashboard"-style page. This is a document layout option, not a table.
read_or_look_through_pdf: Read, inspect, search, and quote PDFs/files comprehensively, including full reads, specific page ranges, and targeted quote retrieval.

tools.name: create_doc
tools.description: Create a document from a title and RemNote-flavored markdown.

text.description:
RemNote-flavored Markdown parsed into a nested outline. Use Markdown bullets and indentation for parent-child structure. Standard headings, emphasis, links, inline code, fenced code blocks, and LaTeX are supported.

To insert a native reference to an existing Rem, use [[label]](/doc/REM_ID), where REM_ID is the exact ID returned by a RemNote tool. A standard [label](url) remains an inline link instead of a native Rem reference.

Flashcard syntax:
- Forward: Question >> Answer
- Backward: Answer << Question
- Bidirectional: Term <> Definition
- Concept: Term :: Definition
- Descriptor: Attribute ;; Value
- Cloze: Text with {{hidden answer}} or {{c1::hidden answer::optional hint}}
- Multi-line: Question === followed by indented answer bullets
- Numbered multi-line: Question >>1. followed by indented answer bullets
- Multiple-choice: Question >>A) followed by indented answer-choice bullets; put the correct answer first

Examples:
- Question===
    - First answer line
    - Second answer line
- Question>>A)
    - Correct answer
    - Distractor

Use :: only for concept cards; it does not make child bullets the answer.

tools.name: insert_simple_table
tools.description: Insert a simple table (plain text columns and rows).

id.description: A raw Rem ID returned by another RemNote MCP tool.

title.description: Title for the table. If id is omitted, a new document with this title is created to hold the table. Provide either id or title.

columns.description: Ordered column headers. The FIRST column is the primary column (the main label for each row).

rows.description: Each row is either a plain string (used as the value for the primary/first column) or an object { name, cells }. For the object form, set name to the value for the primary column and put the other columns in cells. Every row must have a non-empty name or be a non-empty string.

name.description: The value for the primary (first) column, i.e. the main label for the row. Required and non-empty when using the object form.

cells.description: Map of the OTHER (non-primary) column names to their values. Do not put the primary column here; use name instead.

tools.name: insert_advanced_table
tools.description: Insert an advanced table/database (supports select columns, AI autofill, text-to-speech, and flashcards).

id.description: A raw Rem ID returned by another RemNote MCP tool.

title.description: Title for the table. If id is omitted, a new document with this title is created to hold the table. Provide either id or title.

columns.description: Ordered column definitions. The FIRST column is the primary column (the main label for each row) and is always a text column.

rows.description: Each row is either a plain string (used as the value for the primary/first column) or an object { name, cells }. For the object form, set name to the value for the primary column and put the other columns in cells. Every row must have a non-empty name or be a non-empty string.

name.description: The value for the primary (first) column, i.e. the main label for the row. Required and non-empty when using the object form.

cells.description: Map of the OTHER (non-primary) column names to their values. Use a string for text/single_select columns, or an array of strings for multi_select. Do not put the primary column here; use name instead.
